lines.text: Via delle Fornaci 7 · Borgo Valdorso (TO) · Production plant
Change: from 1 November to 31 March add 1.5 kg bentonite
anti-settling agent per 1000 kg batch (winter dose).

cold storage causes hard settling (DR-1998-007). To be applied
as long as finished goods are stored in M2.
